title: Embedded residue criterion
statement: For prime ell, finite embedded E, a generator pi of its maximal ideal, and a Noetherian scheme X, the canonical constant-coefficient restriction of an arbitrary continuous integral-coefficient derived object K satisfies the Stacks criterion if and only if K is complete and its first derived residue reduction has the specified bounded constructible etale origin. All maps and predicates are the canonical ones of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients]; finiteness and discreteness of the actual residue ring are conclusions.

proof.text: Rewrite the uniformizer ideal as the maximal ideal to prove residue finiteness. Identify this ideal with the open valuation unit ball and apply discreteness of the quotient topology.
Use completeness reflection for arbitrary complexes and the cohomological first-residue comparison.

The specified residue realization is exact, so its right derived functor agrees canonically with its termwise derived functor. Apply the finite-ring constructible derived-origin theorem to that termwise image, compose its essential-image isomorphism with the canonical comparison, and insert or discard the finite/discrete witnesses.

lean.statement:
theorem embeddedIntegral_residue_criterion
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E))) :
    IntegralModelsEmbedded.stacksConstructible ℓ E π X
        ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X).obj K) ↔
      IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X K ∧
        integralModelResidueEtaleOrigin X ℓ E π K
